title: 第3章 刚建好账号就遇到大BOSS的赶脚
slug: 无限气运主宰全本免费-无限气运主宰最新章节列表
content_zh:
感觉就是困倦，好像穿越轮回空间，丧失了自己所有的体力一般！
身体慢慢的重新取回了知觉，身体，有柔软的触感。
很舒适的感觉，好像身处在最温柔的怀抱中一样！
是母亲吗？
楚南印象中那个温柔的母亲，总是笑着面对自己……突然多了十余年的记忆，苏景发现，自己二十多年的记忆，竟然不敌楚南区区十余年，感觉反而是楚南的影响力，更为强大一些。
这来自于母亲的感觉，竟能让自己这般沉醉！
所以说，我现在到底是楚南还是苏景？
不知道，但苏景已经本能的一把拉住了那温柔女子的手。
正要说话，小腹却突然一痛……
闷哼一声，他整个人已经被踹飞出去好远好远！
体内顿时如刀绞一般剧痛，整个人直接在地上绻缩成了一团虾米……
正奇怪着，身体却突然仿若坠入了寒冷的冰窖之内，由内而外散发出了强烈的森寒之气，瞬间，天地之间陷入了三九寒天。
哪怕苏景十年锻骨，体内骨骼早已经千锤百炼，也完全无法忍受……
浑身上下都悉悉索索的哆嗦了起来，牙齿更是发出了咯吱咯吱的清脆响声！
但借着这股寒意刺激，楚南也终于能够勉强睁开了自己的眼睛，看清面前这对自己施暴的到底是何人！
可看到后……
他却忍不住愣了！
只因为动手之人，竟然是一名极为美丽的女子！
白衣胜雪，长发如云；风姿绰约，宛如君临天下的女皇……
美的仿佛带着魔力，让人不敢直视！

果然又穿越了！
这里真的是绝代双骄的世界？
那么她是……
苏景心底突然有不详的预感！
果然，下一刻，苏景的不详预感瞬间成真，那女子的脸上露出了扭曲的疯狂笑意，笑道：“果然有骨气，你竟然能在我的明玉功之下还坚持不说出你主子的下落，当真有种，不过我倒要看看，你能撑多久！”
明玉功？！
主神我日你先人板板……给我的评价是弱鸡了都，怎么还直接把我丢到了邀月的跟前了？还特么的是……
苏景的念头蓦然中断，只觉得那女子的笑容和声音仿佛视频的帧数被拉长一般，本来清脆凄厉的笑声渐渐变得粗厚缓慢，而她的笑容也被放慢了无数倍，嘴唇慢慢的张合……
耳边除了那个女子缓慢的声音之外……
还有一道机械平淡的声音说道：【轮回世界主神试炼开启！】
【本试炼场共一人进行试炼！肉身置换、穿越随机选择！】
【定位置换！】
【随机置换人物：江琴，江枫的书童！】
【任务背景简介：玉郎江枫因江湖仇杀被绣玉谷移花宫宫主邀月所救，以其英俊相貌得到大宫主邀月的倾心，他却爱上了移花宫侍女花月奴，并与之私奔，绝色天骄邀月无法容忍这等侮辱，誓要让江枫付出惨重代价！此时，江枫妻子花月奴因为怀孕无法长途跋涉，派遣书童江琴去寻天下第一大侠燕南天来援，中途却遭到邀月的袭击！】
【主线任务：平安存活，并保护江枫、花月奴一家四口平安！任务时间：七天！任务成功奖励气运值1000点！偏差值50点！任务失败则抹消宿主轮回世界记忆和肉体，复制身体送回原世界，从此再不能入轮回！注：该世界为试炼世界，所以无法额外获得气运值和偏差值。】
“什……什么？让我保护江枫？！”
虽然被那女子用手掐着，但此时时间被拉慢，苏景已经感受不到什么痛楚，或者说就算有痛楚，也及不上他此时心底的震惊！
玉郎江枫！绣玉谷移花宫！邀月！
我是江琴？那个日后义薄云天的江别鹤？
我现在正在邀月的手里？

让我保护江枫？
特么的我才是更需要保护的那个人吧？
来不及震惊……
那道机械的声音已经继续说道：【任务开始！倒计时，十、九、八、七、六……】
那个主神没有骗自己，真的是无限流？！！！
但跟自己想象中不一样，之前那个主神口口声声说是陌生的轮回世界，但结果自己来的，却是作为苏景，前世里耳熟能详的世界！
这是怎么回事？
不知道原因，但苏景情愿是个陌生的世界！
毕竟移花宫主邀月，别人不知道，苏景还能不知道她？
只因为跟妹妹的一点小小争执，便能毫不犹豫的将妹妹摔成残废，面对心爱之人也能毫不手软的绝情之人！

content_en:
I feel just sleepy, as if I have lost all my physical strength after traveling through the space of reincarnation!
The body slowly regained consciousness, and the body felt soft to the touch.
It feels very comfortable, as if I am in the gentlest embrace!
Is it the mother?
The gentle mother in Chu Nan's impression always faced him with a smile... Su Jing suddenly had more than ten years of memories. Su Jing found that his memories of more than twenty years were not as good as those of Chu Nan's mere ten years. It felt that Chu Nan's influence was more powerful.
This feeling from my mother can make me so intoxicated!
So, am I Chu Nan or Su Jing now?
He didn't know, but Su Jing instinctively took the gentle woman's hand.
Just as I was about to speak, I felt a sudden pain in my lower abdomen...
With a muffled groan, he was kicked far, far away!
My body suddenly felt like a sharp pain, and my whole body shrank into a ball of shrimp on the ground...
Just as it was strange, his body suddenly seemed to fall into a cold ice cellar, exuding a strong cold air from the inside out. In an instant, the world fell into a freezing cold weather.
Even though Su Jing had been training his bones for ten years and the bones in his body had been tempered countless times, he still couldn't bear it...
His whole body was trembling, and his teeth were making a crisp sound!
But with the stimulation of this chill, Chu Nan was finally able to forcefully open his eyes and see clearly who was violently raping him in front of him!
But after seeing...
But he couldn't help being stunned!
Just because the person who did it turned out to be an extremely beautiful woman!
Her white clothes are as white as snow, her hair is as long as clouds; she is graceful and graceful, like a queen who rules the world...
It's so beautiful that it seems to have magical power, making people afraid to look directly at it!
Sure enough, I traveled through time again!
Is this really a world of peerless pride?
Then she is...
Su Jing suddenly had an unknown premonition in his heart!
Sure enough, at the next moment, Su Jing's ominous premonition came true. A twisted and crazy smile appeared on the woman's face, and she said with a smile: "Sure enough, you have the guts to insist on not telling the whereabouts of your master under my Mingyu Skill. You are really brave, but I want to see how long you can last!"
Ming Yu Gong? !
Lord God, you, my ancestor, Banban... gave me the evaluation of a weakling, so why did you just throw me in front of Yao Yue? What’s even more special is…
Su Jing's thoughts were suddenly interrupted. He felt that the woman's smile and voice were as if the frames of the video had been stretched. The originally crisp and shrill laughter gradually became thick and slow, and her smile was also slowed down countless times, and her lips slowly opened and closed...
Except for the woman's slow voice...
There was also a mechanical and plain voice saying: [The Lord God Trial of the Reincarnation World begins! 】
[A total of one person will be tested in this trial site! Physical body replacement, time travel and random selection! 】
[Positioning replacement! 】
[Random replacement of characters: Jiang Qin, Jiang Feng’s book boy! 】
[Mission Background Introduction: Yulang Jiang Feng was rescued by Yao Yue, the master of Yihua Palace in Xiuyu Valley, due to a vendetta. With his handsome appearance, he won the admiration of Yao Yue, the palace owner. However, he fell in love with Hua Yue Nu, the maid of Yihua Palace, and eloped with her. The stunning genius Yao Yue could not tolerate such insults and vowed to make Jiang Feng pay a heavy price! At this time, Jiang Feng's wife Hua Yuenu was unable to travel long distances because she was pregnant, so she sent the book boy Jiang Qin to find the world's greatest hero Yan Nantian for help, but was attacked by Yao Yue on the way! 】
[Main mission: Survive safely and protect the safety of Jiang Feng and Hua Yuenu’s family of four! Mission time: seven days! A successful mission will reward you with 1,000 luck points! The deviation is worth 50 points! If the mission fails, the memory and body of the host's reincarnation world will be erased, and the body will be copied and sent back to the original world, and will never be able to enter reincarnation again! Note: This world is a trial world, so you cannot obtain additional luck values ​​and deviation values. 】
"Wha...what? You want me to protect Jiang Feng?!"Although he was pinched by the woman's hands, time was being slowed down at this time, and Su Jing could no longer feel any pain. In other words, even if there was pain, it was not as much as the shock in his heart at this time!
Yulang Jiangfeng! Xiuyu Valley and Yihua Palace! Invite the moon!
Am I Jiang Qin? That Jiang Biehe who would be so righteous in the future?
Am I in Yaoyue's hands now?
Want me to protect Jiang Feng?
Am I the one who needs protection more?
Too late to be shocked...
The mechanical voice continued: [The mission begins! Countdown, ten, nine, eight, seven, six...]
That main god didn't lie to himself, was he really infinite? ! ! !
But it was different from what I imagined. The main god kept saying it was a strange world of reincarnation, but in the end, it was a world that I was familiar with in my previous life as Su Jing!
What's going on?
I don’t know the reason, but Su Jing is willing to be in a strange world!
After all, the master of Yihua Palace invites Yue, and others don’t know about it. How can Su Jing not know about her?
Just because of a small dispute with his sister, he can beat her to a cripple without hesitation, and he is a ruthless person who can show no mercy to the one he loves!
